summary: 8 film announcements, 13 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: The Final Girl Support Group
film.talent: Christopher Landon (director/adapter); Barbara Muschietti, Andy Muschietti (producers)
film.announcement: Paramount has greenlit the adaptation of the novel with Christopher Landon directing and adapting the screenplay, with Aperture and the Muschiettis' Double Dream producing.

film.title: Richard Pryor
film.announcement: Biopic based on Elizabeth Stordeur Pryor's memoir 'Something We Said' is in development from Latigo Films and Inaugural Entertainment.

film.title: Tormented Souls
film.studio: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe, Longevity Pictures
film.announcement: ZQ Entertainment, Prime Universe, and Longevity Pictures have acquired film and TV rights to the horror video game for adaptation.

film.title: Thud
film.talent: Sarah Michelle Gellar, Rudy Pankow; Steve Agee, Karan Soni, and five others added to cast
film.announcement: Grim Reaper-Devil romance film starring Sarah Michelle Gellar and Rudy Pankow adds seven cast members including Steve Agee and Karan Soni.

film.title: Show of Hands
film.announcement: Frank Grillo to lead the political kidnapping comedy directed by P.J. Pesce.

film.title: Live 2 Die
film.talent: Ron Perlman, Esai Morales, Josh Bowman
film.announcement: Josh Bowman joins Ron Perlman and Esai Morales in the action film.

film.title: American Summer
film.announcement: Family comedy starring Steve Guttenberg and Christie Brinkley receives a release date.

film.title: Possession
film.talent: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen, Nicholas Alexander Chavez
film.announcement: Madeline Brewer, Emory Cohen, and Nicholas Alexander Chavez join the cast of Paramount's 'Possession'.

tv.title: Task
tv.announcement: Martha Plimpton and Silvia Dionicio confirmed to return for Season 2 of HBO's 'Task'.

tv.title: Chad Powers
tv.announcement: Season 2 of 'Chad Powers' sets fall release date with first look photos; Glen Powell aims to lead South Georgia Catfish to college football playoffs.

tv.title: Reacher
tv.talent: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, Ciara Bravo, Alan Ritchson
tv.announcement: Jay Baruchel, Kevin Durand, Amanda Ip, and Ciara Bravo join 'Reacher' for Season 5 opposite Alan Ritchson.

tv.title: Young Sherlock
tv.talent: Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, Aidan Gillen
tv.announcement: Season 2 adds Sophie Skelton, Indira Varma, Olivia Williams, and Aidan Gillen to cast; returning cast and departures announced.

tv.title: Robin Hood
tv.announcement: Graeme Thomas King upped to series regular for Season 2, playing Prince John.

tv.title: The Earliest Show
tv.talent: Chris Pratt, Lamorne Morris, Sarah Silverman
tv.announcement: Chris Pratt, Lamorne Morris, Sarah Silverman, and 11 other guest stars announced for the series.

tv.title: Chicago Fire
tv.announcement: Original cast member Joe Miñoso announced to be leaving the series after Season 15.

tv.title: American Idol
tv.announcement: 'American Idol' renewed for Season 10 on ABC, marking its 25th overall season.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: 'Silo' star Shane McRae cast in AMC's NASCAR series 'Thunder Road'.

tv.title: The Daily Show
tv.announcement: 'The Daily Show' sets 30th Anniversary Podcast hosted by the news team.

tv.title: Myron Bolitar
tv.announcement: Harlan Coben discusses bringing 'Myron Bolitar' to Netflix, currently in filming.

tv.title: Best in Class
tv.announcement: Comcast's Xfinity launches creator reality series 'Best in Class' hosted by Katie Feeney.
